# Macworld — Mac conversion reaches duplication

- Original source: [Robin Hood to ship by early Dec.](https://www.macworld.com/article/173354/robinhood-2.html)
- Author / publication: Peter Cohen; Macworld.
- Language / date: English; 2004-11-18.
- Access: Full article text inspected.
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Format: original summary and research notes; not a transcript.

Cohen reports that e.p.i.c. interactive’s Mac conversion has reached gold master and entered duplication, with shipping expected within two weeks. The article distinguishes European distribution by e.p.i.c. from United States distribution by Freeverse.

It lists historical requirements of a 300 MHz G3, Mac OS X 10.2, 128 MB RAM, and 8 MB VRAM, and points to a playable demo. This documents manufacturing status and an anticipated shipping window, not confirmation that stores actually received the game on that schedule.
